parts.style: warm, gentle, calm, settling into a slow bedtime tone
parts.text: Let this be a quiet moment. <short pause> The day is done. Whatever it held... it is finished now. <short pause> You can let your shoulders drop. <short pause> Let your hands rest open, and still. <short pause> Feel the weight of your body, held safely where you lie. <short pause> There is nothing more for you to carry tonight. <short pause> Breathe in slowly... <short pause> and out, a little longer. <short pause> Let each breath be soft, and easy.

parts.style: tender, intimate, very soft, speaking slowly
parts.text: Some days are heavy. Some days ask too much of us. <short pause> There are moments when weariness runs deeper than the body... when discouragement feels like a blanket you cannot throw off. <short pause> Tonight, if that is where you are... you are not alone.

parts.style: tender, intimate, very soft, speaking slowly
parts.text: God sees the weight you have carried. <short pause> He knows the hours that felt too long... the words that hurt... the disappointments that piled up like stones. <short pause> And even now... he is near.

parts.style: soft, slow, soothing guided meditation voice
parts.text: Take another slow breath in. <short pause> And release it fully.

parts.style: tender, intimate, very soft, speaking slowly
parts.text: This day will not last forever. <short pause> Darkness does not have the final word. <short pause> There is a promise woven into the rhythm of time itself. <short pause> Night falls, yes. <short pause> But morning always comes.

parts.style: soft, slow, soothing guided meditation voice
parts.text: The psalmist knew this. <short pause> He had seen sorrow... and he had seen the faithfulness of God meet him there. <short pause> And so he wrote these words.
For his anger endureth but a moment; in his favour is life: weeping may endure for a night, but joy cometh in the morning. <short pause> Psalm thirty, verse five. <long pause>

parts.style: tender, intimate, very soft, speaking slowly
parts.text: Weeping may endure for a night... but joy comes in the morning. <short pause> Not because we have solved everything. Not because the trouble has vanished. <short pause> But because God's mercy is new every day. <short pause> Because he does not leave us in the dark.

parts.style: soft, slow, soothing guided meditation voice
parts.text: Let your breathing slow even more now. <short pause> Picture the sky before dawn. <short pause> Still, and quiet... but not empty. <short pause> The light is already on its way.

parts.style: tender, intimate, very soft, speaking slowly
parts.text: You do not have to manufacture hope tonight. <short pause> You do not have to fix what is broken before you sleep. <short pause> You only have to rest... trusting that God is faithful. <short pause> He holds tomorrow. <short pause> He holds you. <short pause> And when the morning comes... his mercies will come with it.

parts.style: soft, slow, soothing guided meditation voice
parts.text: So close your eyes... and breathe. <short pause> Let the silence settle around you, like a refuge.

parts.style: prayerful, hushed, very slow, a gentle blessing
parts.text: The Lord bless you, and keep you. <short pause> The Lord make his face shine upon you, and be gracious to you. <short pause> The Lord lift up his countenance upon you... and give you peace.
